g.text: Command forwarded to the owner replica — PATCH /api/aircrafts/{registrationNumber}/status (US105, contract B3b)
Unicast: peers are tried ONE AT A TIME.
Same method, path, body and JWT; X-Peer-Hops: 1.
[aircraft is IN_FLIGHT and the target is UNDER_MAINTENANCE / INACTIVE]
409 {"error": "Aircraft CS-TUC is in flight and cannot change to ..."}
propagated with its status and message
Single owner per record: only aircraftmanagement-2 writes CS-TUC, so replicas never conflict.
When Maintenance calls B3b the same flow runs; a 409/503 is propagated to Maintenance,
which must not start or complete its record (contract B3b).
